text: Ollama's OpenAI layer implements /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions, /v1/models, /v1/embeddings and /v1/responses. Chat supports streaming, JSON mode, seed, tools, base64 vision and reasoning control; logprobs are unsupported. Embeddings reject token-array input. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: The OpenAI layer launched 2024-02-08 as 'initial experimental support' for chat completions only; embeddings, function calling, vision and logprobs were listed as future work and have since been added (except logprobs). (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: Chat completions does not support tool_choice, logit_bias, user or n per Ollama docs. A llama-stack project fix (PR #2047, Apr 2025) worked around Ollama still calling tools when tool_choice="none" by stripping tools from the request. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: Anthropic layer supports messages, streaming, system prompts, tools and tool results, base64 images, thinking blocks and output_config.effort. Not supported: /v1/messages/count_tokens, tool_choice, metadata, cache_control prompt caching, Batches, citations, PDF document blocks, streaming error events. budget_tokens is accepted but not enforced; token counts are approximate. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: Anthropic-compatible proxies can fail on Claude Code's experimental beta parameters (400 errors); agentgateway documents CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1 as the workaround. Whether this applies to Ollama is untested here. The hosted Ollama endpoint rejects anthropic-version older than 2023-06-01. (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: OpenAI-compatible base URL is http://localhost:11434/v1/ locally and https://ollama.com/v1 for cloud (OLLAMA_API_KEY). Locally the client must send some API key value, but Ollama ignores it. (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: /v1/responses (added in v0.13.3) supports streaming, function tools and reasoning summaries but only the non-stateful flavor: previous_response_id, conversation and truncation are unavailable. Cloud also lacks built-in web search through it. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: Clients wanting OpenAI model names can alias a local model with `ollama cp llama3.2 gpt-3.5-turbo`. The OpenAI API has no context-size field; set num_ctx via a Modelfile PARAMETER and `ollama create`. (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: Anthropic Messages compatibility is served at /v1/messages (local http://localhost:11434, cloud https://ollama.com). Clients set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=ollama (ignored locally). It requires Ollama v0.14.0+ (blog dated 2026-01-16). (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints

text: Ollama recommends at least 32K context for Claude Code use; cloud models always run at full context. For tools expecting Anthropic model names, alias with `ollama cp qwen3-coder claude-3-5-sonnet`. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility endpoints
